title: Selected source-reviewed activities of exact APS legal applicants
scope: Purposeful partial review; not a representative industry census and not an ultimate-parent mapping.
matchingRule: Exact Applicant Name from APS, after trimming outer whitespace only; no fuzzy matching, aliases, group propagation or string-based sector inference.

entries.evidence: The applicant describes developing and operating domain-name infrastructure; APS identifies the legal applicant.
ICANN identifies this legal entity as the .xyz operator; the business describes a portfolio of domain extensions.
The .biz registry agreement names the entity; ICANN's evaluated registry-services list documents its registry-services activity.
The company identifies itself by its legal name as a provider of domain extensions.
The .store agreement identifies the operator; APS discloses this entity's registry and registrar-industry relationships.

AGB Q11-Q12 describe the applying entity as a subsidiary of an existing registry operator. Sector is an editorial reading of the applying vehicle's declared activity, not proof that it already operates an awarded 2026 TLD.
Google Registry identifies its registry legal entity as Charleston Road Registry. This classification concerns that applicant's domain business, not the consolidated activities of Google or Alphabet.

AGB Q11-Q14 identify the applying registry vehicle and its relationship to accredited domain registrars. Sector is an editorial reading of the applicant's declared domain-industry role, not a consolidated parent-sector classification.
APS links this legal applicant to openai.com; the organization's stated activity is artificial-intelligence research and deployment. This is not inferred from the .agent string.
The organization's company page identifies a public benefit corporation devoted to advanced AI development and research.

The service site names Aruba PEC S.p.A. as the provider of certified mail, digital identity and trust services; AgID lists the legal entity. This concerns Aruba PEC, not every activity of the Aruba group.
